title: Magic
subtitle: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks: from a first scroll to legendary ink

quests.title: Inscription Table
description: Magic here is learned from scrolls and kept in spell books.
Craft an Inscription Table: a book on top of three wooden slabs and two fences.
It's where you write a scroll's spell into a spell book, so you can cast it again and again.

quests.title: A First Spell Book
description: Spell books hold your spells. The first two are cheap: the Flimsy Journal (copper, string and paper) and the Ironbound Tome (chains, leather and paper).
Equip one: a spell book goes in its own Curios slot.

quests.title: Scrolls
description: Scrolls are your first spells. You find them in chests, take them from spellcasting mobs, or make them later at a Scroll Forge.
Reading a scroll casts its spell once and uses it up. Better: put the scroll and your spell book in the Inscription Table and inscribe the spell into the book.
You can take the scroll back out later; the spell leaves the book with it.

quests.title: Casting Spells
description: With a spell book equipped, hold R to open the spell wheel and pick a spell, then press V to cast it. Left Alt with the mouse wheel also steps through your spells.
Every cast costs mana, which refills over time.
These are the default keys: Controls lists them under Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks.

tasks.title: I've cast a spell from my spell book

quests.title: Wandering Magician
description: Arcane Essence is the base of most magic gear. A little turns up in chests, even in vanilla structures; far more in the mod's magic structures, each guarded by a mage who won't like you taking it.
Craft a leather chestplate with one Arcane Essence: Wandering Magician armor raises your max mana. The other leather pieces work the same way.

quests.title: Wizard Robes
description: Arcane Cloth is eight Arcane Essence around a block of wool. Eight cloth make the Wizard Robes; the hat or hood, leggings and boots are cloth too.
Later, craft a piece with a school rune and one Arcane Essence (or use the rune as a smithing template) to turn it into that school's armor: Pyromancer for fire, Cryomancer for ice, and so on.

quests.title: Ink
description: Ink comes in five rarities, common to legendary. You find it in magic chests and on spellcasting mobs.
The rarer the ink, the higher the level of the scroll you can make with it.

quests.title: Scroll Forge
description: Craft a Scroll Forge from three polished deepslate and four crying obsidian.
Put in ink, paper and a school's focus item, then pick a spell from the list: the focus sets the school, the ink the rarity. Now you choose your spells instead of hoping for them.

quests.title: Schools and Runes
description: Each school of magic has a focus item: blaze rod (fire), frozen bone (ice), Bottle o' Lightning (lightning), divine pearl (holy), ender pearl (ender), blood vial (blood), emerald (evocation), poisonous potato (nature).
Blank Runestones turn up in magic structures. Ring one with eight of a focus to make that school's rune, for school armor. A school's mage always drops its rune.

quests.title: Alchemist Cauldron
description: The Alchemist Cauldron is a cauldron, iron, Arcane Essence and Cinder Essence. Cinder Essence drops from Ancient Knights, who wake when you break armor piles in the Nether.
Pour in four bottles of common ink and add a copper ingot for a bottle of uncommon; iron, gold and amethyst step up the rarer inks the same way.
Scrolls you don't need, put in while it holds water, can melt into ink of their rarity.

quests.title: Arcane Anvil
description: Craft the Arcane Anvil: three amethyst blocks, a diamond, an anvil and two polished deepslate.
Combine a scroll with ink one rarity up to raise the spell's level. Combine a weapon with a scroll to imbue the weapon with that spell. Upgrade orbs improve armor and spell books here too.

quests.title: Enchanted Spell Book
description: Each better book holds more spells. The Apprentice's Spell Book is gold, Arcane Essence and hogskin (hoglins drop it).
The Enchanted Spell Book is diamonds, hogskin, Arcane Cloth and an enchanted book.

quests.title: Ancient Codex
description: Restore a Ruined Book, found in Ancient Cities, into the Ancient Codex with netherite, Arcane Cloth, two Blood Vials and a Bottle o' Lightning.
Blood Vials come from cooking mobs in a cauldron with a campfire under it, or in an Alchemist Cauldron. A Bottle o' Lightning is an empty bottle used on a charged creeper.

quests.title: Wayward Compass
description: Craft a Wayward Compass: four Arcane Essence and four iron around a soul lantern.
The soul trapped in it points toward the Catacombs, a crypt deep underground.

quests.title: The Catacombs
description: Follow the compass down into the Catacombs.
Its crypts hold scrolls, runestones and Blood Vials, and the Dead King lies at its heart. Bring light and food.

quests.title: Artificer's Cane
description: Staffs and canes are casting implements: hold one and press use (right-click) to cast your selected spell. Most also strengthen your magic while held.
The Artificer's Cane is crimson planks, gold and an amethyst shard.

quests.title: Ice Staff
description: The Ice Staff joins a Frosted Helve with a Permafrost Shard.

The helve is frozen bones (strays drop them) and Arcane Ingots (eight Arcane Essence around an iron, copper or gold ingot). The shard waits in the captain's quarters of a wrecked icebreaker, in frozen oceans, ice spikes and frozen peaks.
